name: City Shadows
description: Contemporary Chicago, where ordinary people face extraordinary challenges in their daily lives.
seed_prompt: A modern-day urban setting where cops, criminals, and civilians navigate the complexities of city life.
lore_content:
Chicago, the present day. Eight million people, eight million stories. The city runs on ambition, corruption, and the relentless drive to survive another day.

Detective Carmen Rodriguez works Major Crimes in a department riddled with problems. Her clearance rate is the best in the unit, which makes her both valuable and threatening to the old guard. She's investigating a string of disappearances that might connect to City Hall.

Marcus Johnson teaches history at Lincoln High and coaches the basketball team. He grew up on the South Side, got out on a scholarship, came back to make a difference. The gangs are recruiting his students, and he's running out of ways to compete.

Dr. Priya Sharma runs the ER at Cook County General. Gunshots, overdoses, heart attacks - she sees humanity at its worst every night. She's brilliant, exhausted, and privately struggling with an addiction that started as self-medication.

Tony Marinetti is third-generation in the 'waste management' business, which everyone knows is a front. He wants to take the family legitimate, but his uncle Sal thinks that's betrayal. The tension is building toward something that can only end in blood.

Sarah Chen is a journalist at the Tribune investigating a slum landlord whose buildings keep catching fire. Residents die; insurance pays out; the landlord buys more buildings. Sarah's editor is getting nervous about the threats.

Father Michael O'Brien runs a soup kitchen in Pilsen. He struggles with his faith every day, wondering if he's actually helping or just making poverty more comfortable. A dying parishioner confessed something that's shaken him to his core.

In the financial district, Alexandra Moore manages billions for the city's pension fund. She's discovered irregularities that suggest massive fraud. The people responsible have already made one accountant disappear. She's copying files and planning her escape.
